description: This file defines the MidiPortWrapper class, which encapsulates information about a MIDI device and its port, providing methods for retrieving device details, creating string representations, and handling equality comparisons.

classes.name: MidiPortWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper for a MIDI device and port description, providing methods for accessing device info and port details, as well as string representation and equality checks.

methods.name: updateString
methods.description: Updates the string representation of the object based on the current device and port data.

methods.name: findPortInfo
methods.description: Finds and returns the PortInfo object corresponding to the stored port index and type.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object, generating it if necessary.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if this object is equal to another, based on port index, type, and device info.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on the port index, type, and device info.
